dedupe_keys.name: chinese city power generation and carbon emissions 2000 2019

description: The Chinese city power-emissions team publishes annual electricity generation and carbon dioxide estimates for 352 cities from 2000 through 2019. The own Figshare deposit contains one Excel workbook, and the article reports 7,040 city-year records. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These figures can provide historical targets or regional context for energy-transition and emissions scenarios, with model-pypsa a separate network-modelling context. Coverage follows the study's selected cities and administrative definitions; it is not a plant-level generation register. A caveat is that the values are estimated by an allocation method, not measured emissions at each generator. The article notes a negative predicted generation value for Urumqi in 2013 that was excluded from analysis. Boundary and method changes matter when comparing years. The own repository metadata and article Data Records were read without opening workbook cells or recomputing city totals. MATLAB calculation code has a distinct Figshare DOI.
